metal_implant.title: Metal Implant Certificate
metal_implant.content: Certificate No: {{CERTIFICATE_NUMBER}} Date of Issue: {{ISSUE_DATE}} This is to certify that Mr./Ms. {{PATIENT_NAME}}, aged {{PATIENT_AGE}} years, {{PATIENT_GENDER}}, was treated at {{HOSPITAL_NAME}} for the following condition. Diagnosis: {{DIAGNOSIS}} Date of Surgery: {{SURGERY_DATE}} Date of Implant Verification: {{IMPLANT_CHECK_DATE}} Procedure Performed: {{PROCEDURE_PERFORMED}} The above-mentioned implant is a permanent medical device necessary for the patient's treatment and poses no security risk. However, the presence of this metal implant may trigger metal detectors during security screening at airports, seaports, or other secured premises. This certificate is issued to inform security authorities of the presence of the said implant and to facilitate the patient's movement during security checks for travel by air, land, or water. This certificate is limited to confirming the presence of the implant and does not certify overall medical fitness for travel, which may depend on other medical conditions and clinical assessment. This certificate has been issued on the request of the patient for the stated purpose. Should you require any further information, please contact {{HOSPITAL_NAME}} at the details provided above. ____________________ Dr. {{DOCTOR_NAME}} Reg. No: {{DOCTOR_REG}} Department: {{DEPARTMENT}} {{HOSPITAL_NAME}} {{HOSPITAL_ADDRESS}}
